_note: Instagram posts to show on the front page. Meta shut down the personal-account API in December 2024 and oEmbed no longer returns thumbnails, so there is no way to fetch these automatically from a static site. Each entry names an image you place in assets/img/ and the post it links to. Add an entry, drop the file in, rebuild.
